claim.claim-text: 1. A frame (102; 202; 302; 402; 502; 602; 702) for a prosthetic heart valve, the frame (102; 202; 302; 402; 502; 602; 702) being formed of stainless steel and/or a nickel based alloy and comprising:

- an inflow end (103; 203) and an outflow end (105; 205), - a row of outflow cells at the outflow end (105; 205), the row of outflow cells comprising: - a first row of angled struts and a second row of angled struts that each are arranged along a circumference of the stent, and - axial frame members (130, 132; 230, 232; 330, 332; 430, 432; 530, 532; 630, 632; 730, 732) bridging the first row of angled struts and the second row of angled struts, wherein

- the axial frame members (130, 132; 230, 232; 330, 332; 430, 432; 530, 532; 630, 632; 730, 732) bridging the first row of angled struts and the second row of angled struts only extend between the first row of angled struts and the second row of angled struts, and - the outflow cells are formed by a total of six or eight or ten struts.
2. The frame according to claim 1, wherein the axial frame members (130, 132; 230, 232; 330, 332; 430, 432; 530, 532; 630, 632; 730, 732) are configured as axial struts.

3. The frame according to at least one of the preceding claims, wherein the axial frame members (130, 132; 230, 232; 330, 332; 430, 432; 530, 532; 630, 632; 730, 732) comprise at least two axially extending leaflet attachment members configured as axial struts with suture openings that are configured to support a respective commissure of a prosthetic valve member.

4. The frame according to claim 3, wherein there are three or less axially extending struts (132; 232; 332; 432; 532; 632; 732) between adjacent leaflet attachment members (130; 230; 330; 430; 530; 630; 730).
5. The frame according to at least one of the preceding claims, being formed of a nickel-cobalt-chromium-molybdenum alloy.

6. A prosthetic heart valve (100; 200) comprising the frame (102; 202; 302; 402; 502; 602; 702) according to at least one of the preceding claims, and a valvular structure (104; 204), an inner skirt (106; 206), and an outer skirt (108; 208).
7. The prosthetic heart valve according to claim 6, wherein the valvular structure (104; 204) comprises three leaflets (110).
8. The prosthetic heart valve according to claim 7, wherein the leaflets (110) are formed of pericardial tissue or of a biocompatible synthetic material.
9. The prosthetic heart valve according to at least one of claims 6 to 8, wherein the inner skirt (106; 206) comprises a tough, tear resistant material.
10. The prosthetic heart valve according to claim 9, wherein the inner skirt (106; 206) comprises polyethylene terephthalate, or a natural material.
11. The prosthetic heart valve according to at least one of claims 6 to 10, wherein the inner skirt (106; 206) is secured to the inside of the frame (102; 202; 302; 402; 502; 602; 702) via sutures.

12. The prosthetic heart valve according to at least one of claims 6 to 11, wherein an upper edge portion of the inner skirt (106; 206) is formed with a plurality of projections that define an undulating shape that follows the shape of that row of struts to which the inner skirt (106; 206) is secured.

13. The prosthetic heart valve according to at least one of claims 6 to 12, wherein the inner skirt (106; 206) is sutured to the frame (102; 202; 302; 402; 502; 602; 702) at locations away from a suture line attaching a lower edges of the leaflets (110) to the inner skirt (106; 206).

14. The prosthetic heart valve according to at least one of claims 6 to 13, wherein a lower edge of the outer skirt (108; 208) is sutured to a lower edge of the inner skirt (106; 206) at the inflow end (103; 203) of the prosthetic heart valve (100; 200).
15. The prosthetic heart valve according to at least one of claims 6 to 13, wherein the inner skirt (106; 206) and the outer skirt (108; 208) are integrally formed as a single component.
